headline: Artemis II Moon Bros 🚀🌕 Dropping 'ALL THE GOOD STUFF' 💎📸 Back to Earth!
text:
Artemis II squad 🧑‍🚀👨‍🚀👩‍🚀🧑‍🚀 – Reid Wiseman 👨‍💼🌑, Victor Glover 🧑🏾‍🚀💨, Christina Koch 👩‍🚀❤️, Jeremy Hansen 🍁🧑‍🚀 – straight MOONED 🌕🍑 the far side of the Luna baddie 🌑🚫👀, snaggin' RECORDS 📈🔥 and 'ALL THE GOOD STUFF' 💦📦 like THICC pics 📸🍑 and wild stories 📖😱 on their way home to splashdown San Diego vibes 🏖️💦 Friday night! Orion ship 🚀🛸 BROKE Apollo 13's dusty 1970 record 🥇📏 at 248k+ miles 🚀🌌 – first human peepers 👀🔭 on far side craters 🕳️🌋 and lava plains 🪨🔥 that sats could only simp for 📡😩!

Pilot Vic Glover 🧑🏾‍🚀🎤 spilling tea ☕ from space: 'We got SO MANY MORE PICS 📸💦, SO MANY STORIES 📜🤯 – the DATA DRIP 🥤📊 you've seen? That's just the appetizer, bby 👅 – GOOD STUFF COMIN' WITH US! 🔥🍆' Crew got TWO DAYS ⏳😵‍💫 to marinate on the lunar flex before re-entry roast 🔥🌪️ at 25k MPH ⚡💨 and para-splash PACIFIC POUND 💥🏄‍♂️ testing that heatshield THICCNESS 🛡️🍑!

Commander Reid Wiseman 👨‍💼🌕 dropped EMOJI TEARS 😭💧 naming a MOON CRATER 🕳️👑 after his late wifey Carroll 💔🕊️ (RIP cancer battle ⚔️😢) – 'Jeremy spelled it out 📝✨, Christina was BAWLING 😢👩‍🚀, pinnacle MOMENT fr fr! 🏔️😍' During 40-min 'profound solitude' blackOUT 🚫📡, they munched Jeremy's maple cookies 🍪🍁😋, reflected like zen space monks 🧘‍♂️🌌, and slayed geology OBS 🧑‍🔬🌑 – 'CRITICAL AF for the rock squad! 🪨🔬'

Glover's GOAT gift? Lunar ECLIPSE VIEW 🌓😱 from BEYOND far side – 'GREATEST GLOW-UP! ✨🌑' Christina Koch 👩‍🚀💖 missin' that CREW CAMARADERIE 🤝❤️ most, but ZERO REGRETS on risks/sacrifices 🎢⚠️: 'Inconvenient? WORTH IT to DIVE DEEPER 🏊‍♂️🌊!' News from Earth? Fam bias drip 📰👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 – 'Public perspective? They're SIMPIN' HARD 🤤😂!' Trump 🍊👨‍💼 even beamed in post-flyby: 'You MADE HISTORY, America PROUD AF 🇺🇸🦅🔥!'

NASA Houston beam-in 🖥️📡 had mics FLOATIN' 🎙️🫧 with Q&A lags 🚀⏳ – LA Times grilled on solitude, BBC's Rebecca Morelle 🎤🧠 probed space FOMO 😩. Now quiet check days 🛠️🔍 before fiery plunge ORDEAL 🔥💥 – but these moon cucks... er, CHADS 🧑‍🚀🥇 are THRUSTIN' BACK loaded with lunar Ls 💎🌕 to SLAY Earth stories FOREVER ♾️😤! Artemis II not landin', just FLYBY FLEX 🌑🚀 – next up? Moon BASE ORGY 🏰👯‍♂️ w/ Artemis III! 🌕🔥‼️
